header.store_rules_checked: 2026-10-30: Apple up to 3 treatments for up to 90 days; Google Play up to 2 variants, stops after 6 months

tests.change: first three screenshots lead with a race-day plan instead of the app tour
three new icons: shoe, track lane, coach whistle
two German short descriptions: plan-first and community-first
feature graphic shows a finish line and the 8-week plan instead of the logo

verdicts.why: 104,616 impressions per arm at 4,000 a day in the slowest arm takes 26.2 days, so 28 days in whole weeks, inside the 42-day wait and Apple's 90 days.

As planned, 3 icons at 30% give each icon 10% of 8,800 daily impressions, and splitting the 10% false-win risk three ways needs 151,602 per arm: 175 days, past Apple's 90. One treatment at the same 30% needs 106,282 per arm and 42 days, just inside the wait. Pick the strongest icon first; alternate icons must ship in the app binary before the test is submitted.

German is 140 visitors a day. Two variants at 50% need 364 days; one variant at 50% still needs 147. In 6 weeks it could only read a lift of 11.1% or more, 1.9 times the 6% you care about, so only a much bolder line could read, and only if you agree to aim for that lift. A short description is per language, so more locales don't help, and App Store tests can't change text. Ship the stronger line on judgement and watch German conversion for 28 days, or test the same idea in English, where the traffic is.
Default graphics reach en-US, es-419 (German has its own graphics, so it is left out): 4,050 visitors a day. 9,596 per arm takes 4.7 days, so 7 days.

flags: Apple runs one test at a time, so T2 waits for T1.
Crosses US Thanksgiving and Black Friday week: that week's visitors may convert differently, so read the result with care or move the start.
Alternate icons must ship in the app binary before the test is submitted.
Crosses New Year resolution week: that week's visitors may convert differently, so read the result with care or move the start.
Play runs one default graphics experiment at a time, so the icon rerun waits for T4.
Crosses US Thanksgiving and Black Friday week: that week's visitors may convert differently, so read the result with care or move the start.

collisions: Apple runs one test at a time: T1 first (28 days), then T2 with its changes (42 days).
Google Play runs one default graphics experiment at a time: T4 first, then the R2 icon rerun.

computed from the export: 95% per treatment, so 90% across both treatments

arms.traffic: about 7,290 visitors in the variant (estimated: 4,050 a day in scope x 20% x 9 days; Play does not export visitors per arm)
arms.scaled_installers_note: Play Console scales each arm to 100% of the audience, so these are not conversions out of the visitors above
arms.interval_source: Play Console's performance range at the 90% confidence set in the console

findings: Treatment A lifted downloads per impression 9.1% (interval 4.2% to 14.1% at 95% per treatment, 90% across both), each arm passed the 49,786 impressions a 10% lift needed, the test ran 42 days (6 whole weeks), and App Store Connect agrees at 99% confidence. Apply it; a video needs no new app version.
Treatment B's 2.1% sits inside an interval that crosses zero (-2.7% to 6.9%). It is a draw, not a second winner.

The Play icon test was stopped after 9 days while the console said 'More data needed'. At a 20% audience the variant saw about 7,290 visitors of the 13,777 a 5% lift needs, and 9 days is not whole weeks. The +4.1% scaled-installer gap is a peek: don't apply the orange icon. Rerun it for 21 days at the same settings, or 7 days at 50%.

mode_3_custom_page_plan.how_to_measure: After 28 days, compare each page with the default page in App Analytics or the default listing in Play Console, on its own traffic. Keep pages that convert above the default; fold the rest back.
findings: 3 themes pass the 10% spend bar out of $22,500 in 30-day app-campaign spend: Beginner 5K 42.5%, Walking for weight loss 17.5%, Marathon training 16.6%.
'running plan' is claimed by Beginner 5K and Marathon training; Apple lets one page own a keyword, so it goes to Beginner 5K (Beginner 5K spends $9,570 in 30 days against $3,730).
Trail running is 2.8% of spend, under the bar: it stays on the default page until it grows.

order_of_work: Apply R1 Treatment A (runner's-view preview video) to the App Store page now.
Start T1 on the App Store (28 days), then T2 as one icon at 30% (42 days) once the icons ship in a release.
Start T4 on Google Play (7 days), then rerun the R2 icon test (21 days at 20%).
Build the 6 custom pages in parallel: they don't touch the tests, which run on the default pages.
Don't run T3; ship the stronger German line on judgement.
